query:
WITH
                current_task AS (
                    SELECT id, running_on
                    FROM durable.task
                    WHERE id = $1
                    LIMIT 1
                ),
                insert_event AS (
                    INSERT INTO durable.event(task_id, index, label, value)
                    SELECT
                        id as task_id,
                        $2 as index,
                        $3 as label,
                        $4 as value
                    FROM current_task
                    WHERE running_on = $6
                    RETURNING task_id
                ),
                insert_log AS (
                    INSERT INTO durable.log(task_id, index, message)
                    SELECT task_id, index, message
                    FROM (VALUES ($1, $2, $5)) as t(task_id, index, message)
                    JOIN current_task task ON task.id = task_id
                    WHERE message IS NOT NULL
                      AND task.running_on = $6
                    RETURNING task_id
                )
            SELECT running_on
             FROM current_task
            LEFT JOIN insert_event event ON event.task_id = id
            LEFT JOIN insert_log   log   ON log.task_id = id
